balls.text: don't rile a fast man. This is full and fast and ferocious, Albie makes room, but his bat comes down after the ball has hit the off stump, an angry Steyn looks at the umpire, and gestures perhaps meaning to say, "That wasn't wide, was it?" or perhaps "So what, the wide didn't cost me much, the extra ball got me a wicket."
full and straight again, and played towards long-off
Flintoff shuffles again, Steyn follows him, beats Flintoff, it's close to a wide, and is called, unfortunate on Steyn, and he lets it be known to the umpire Jerling. Dirty looks there
slower bouncer, Albie, beaten by the pace, tries the scoop over keeper, but it's the toe end, Uthappa leaps high, gets a hand to it, and can;t collect the rebound behind him, while diving
shot, what can you do with a yorker? move away, open the face, and dig it out to point boundary. Where were you so long Albie?
yorker this time, and just a single
what a shot from Flintoff, it's fast, on the stumps, and Fred shuffles towards off, and flicks it flat over square-leg boundary

slower ball, from round the stumps, angling in, and Raina goes on side, lofted shot, and can't clear Kohli at long-on... the UP bowler has the last laugh in this mini UP battle, incidentally during a match being played between two plays from South India
slower ball, just outside off, and almost had Flintoff there, a labourious shot just clears extra cover
full, outside off, and Raina can't connect properly, single into the covers
yorker from round the stumps, right on the money, played back to the bowler
slower, short ball, and Raina pulls it towards square leg, easy four, the UP batsman is having good time against UP bowler - UP being Uttar Pradesh
fulltoss, Flintoff lofts it towrds long-on, one bounce to Kumble
slower, cutting away from Raina, who tries to run it down, but misses
lovely stop by KP, Flintoff backs away, cuts crisply, the ball is bouncing over point, but KP times his jump to perfection, but in over enthusiasm, gives away an overthrow
slower ball, good bluff, and Raina opens the face towards point, and gets a single
PK had come straighter at thirdman, and good he did that, another outside edge from Flintoff, and goes straight towards thirdman
Flintoff makes room again, same delivery, fast and just outside off, and Flintoff gets a thick outside edge to thirdman boundary
full, just outside off, fast and Fred backs away and misses
almost another one for KP, an almighty slog sweep, connects only air, but the ball just spins past off stump, too close
looks to step out, this is bowled flatter, and Flintoff recovers well and takes a single to long-on
short on the pads, and Freddie short-arm-pulls it to square leg boundary
short, on the pads, Raina pulls with all his might, but doesn't connect, a single to midwicket
just outside off, flighted delivery, and Fred gets an easy single to cover
yorker, played back to KP, one can feel the tension
finally Bangalore hold on to a catch. Samrt bowling by PK, Dhoni wants to go over long-on, PK has bowled a legcutter, and the thick outside edge takes it to Bishnoi at long-off, an absolute sitter
lovely slower legcutter, , beats Dhoni who has committed to stepping down
full and stright this time, and played down to long-off
UP to UP, and it's up and over, short and wide, Raina opens the face, deliberately hits in the air, and clears the pioint boundary with ease
slower ball, grips, on the stumps, Dhoni takes one hand off, and plays it towards long-off
easy single to fine leg
Raina survives again, big slog sweep, gets only elevation, straight down the throat of Steyn at deep midwicket, but he drops it, he was on a his knees and the bowl went straight in and straight out
Dhoni steps out, just bunts it towards midwicket, they both want two, Raina more so, but they decide against, but the throw comes at Dhoni's end
takes it from the pads, and turns it around for an easy single
tries the flipper, 97ks, but Dhoni reads it and ricks back to play it towards long-off
fuller, slower, Raina wants a base-ball slog, but is early in the shot, and inside-edges it safely
just short of length, just outside off, and cut straight to sweeper-cover
hit just wide of long-on, and these two, quick runners, put Bishnoi under immense pressure, and take a comfortable two
full, flat, on the stumps, and Dhoni takes a single to long-on
flat and down leg
fulltoss, on the pads, Dhoni rocks back, and uses the bottom hand to put it over square leg
full, and on stumps again, and played towards long-off
flat, full, and on the leg stump, and played to wide of fine leg
full, on the stumps, grips a bit, and Raina plays it towards long-off
short and straight, and another single towards mid-off region
flighted, pitching just outside leg, and turning, and Raina defends
Dhoni steps out, is beaten in the flight, but still manages a single to long-on
another short delivery, and flat-batted towards long-off
short, on the stumps, and played down towards long-on
short and wide, and helped away for a single
full, on the pads, and driven straight down the ground
short and just outside off, Dhoni flat-bats it to long-on
on the pads, and turned away towards fine leg for an easy single
short and wide, but can't beat the thirdman
flighted, on the pads, Raina wants a quick single, but can't get it far enough
Kumble bowls fumm and straight, and no room for Raina
Dhoni lunges forward, and plays with an open face, but can't beat point. Two runs, two wickets, what an over
short, turning away, and an easy single into the off side
full, driven away, and can't beat KP
short on the stumps, and Dhoni helps it into the leg side

is this the charm of KP or what? Hayden is gone, run-out. Raina wants to get off the mark, drops it towards point, and charges off. Hayden responds, but there never was a run in there, Dravid rushes in, swoops, and throws in a single fluid motion, and hits the off stump, beating Hayden's dive
Will he ever? Strategy time-out has worked for Bangalore. KP bowls full and straight, and Parthiv slog-sweeps all over it, and Uthappa collects the off stumps
on the pads, and played away towards midwicket, easy single
traditional sweep this time, and can't beat the alert Uthappa, who has moved quickly down the leg
tries the reverse sweep this time, but can't beat point
fabulous shot, Hayden walks across, gets down on a knee, and sweeps past fine leg
Hayden steps out, mis-hits, because he was beaten in the flight, but somehow manages to find the vacant area between long-off and extra-cover
full on the stumps, and swept away
better bowling, on the stumps, and played with an open face for a single
slower, short, and Parthiv cuts it, and finds the gap to perfection
slower yorker, 101ks, and Hayden manages to hit it towards long-on
Hayden walks down again, Kallis fires in quick and straight, and Hayden misses, but gets four leg byes
quicker, on the stumps, and Parthiv late-cuts it from in front of the stumps
slowish, 112ks, and Hayden archs back and opens the face for a single
Hayden steps out, and drop-kicks it to deep backward square leg for two
full and straight, single to long-on
full, and a single to long-off
even slower, 75ks, beats the Hayden sweep again, big shout, and for not given
even slower, 80ks</I, and beats the Hayden sweep
slower in the air, full, Hayden plays for spin, and is beaten by the straighter one
short and wide down the leg, part-time keeper, five runs, thank you
just short of a length, on the pads, and Hayden keeps the strike with an easy single
full, slower fulltoss, outside off, and Hayden gets to ffity with a guide past third man
looks for a home run, Kohli changes his pace, 103k, and beats Hayden
as with part-timers, the loose delivery appears, and Hayden gets down on a knee and paddles it past fine leg, which is in circle
full and wide, swinging away, and Hayden can't squeeze it past point
right-arm medium it is, yorker on the leg stump, and Hayden blocks it
that's better, full, and on the stumps, and Hayden can hit to just wide of mid-off for a single
slower ball, short one, too short, and Hayden scoops it over the short fine leg, can't bowl short with thirdman and fine leg up in the circle. Use your head, bowler
short and wide again, and Hayden finds the gap again, through the off cordon of four, smooth as you like
stays his ground this time, and pulls a short delivery to deep midwicket
steps down again, and connects only with air
and Parthiv lives for more, steps down, mis-hits, and just clears mid-on
slower ball from round the stumps, but it's too full, and Hayden lofts it with an open face, up and over long-off
Parthiv survives again, bouncer, top-edged, lands in no-man's land
walks down, drives it down the ground with all his might, and Kumble cuts it off at long-on
the best of the three shots, it's just outside off, and Hayden late-cuts it between point and thirdman, also in circle
short, and on leg, and Hayden shows it past fine leg, which is in circle
loosener, and gets a royal spanking, short and outside off, and Hayden murders it to wide of mid-off
yorked him, and Parthiv wants a quick single, Steyn and Parthiv race for the striker's end, and Parthiv beats the bowler
another slower ball, on the stumps, but Parthiv archs back a little, and guides it to thirdman
beaten outside off again, fast and moving away
that's a smoke of a pull, Parthiv sees the short ball early, rocks back, and deposits it into the square leg boundary
slower ball again, 123k, on the stumps, Parthiv commits, but manages to control the shot
beats Parthiv outside off
what does PK do? bowl a fulltoss, and Hayden helps it over square leg. Six and out
yorker, angling in, and Parthiv helps it out to sweeper in the leg side
shortish, on the stumps, flat-batted to wide of Kumble at mid-on
slower ball, 109k, and Hayden can hit straight to mid-off only
another wristy hit from Parthiv, in the air this time, bottom-edge, and it just clears the ring again. Twice lucky
full, not swinging, at 125k, asked to be hit, and hit Parthiv does, wristily, through the gap between mid-on and midwicket
there goes the famous Hayden walk, Steyn cuts down the pace, and beats Hayden's swipe with a 124k delivery
full again, a touch slower at 135k, Hayden is early into the shot, but turns his wrists and goes leg side, and clears the inner ring with ease
another wide delivery, very close to being called a wide, Hayden lets it go
full and wide, and angling away, called wide, and rightfully so
full this time, Parthiv throws his arms again, and limply lobs it over mid-off
just short of length, on target, and Parthiv doesn't have any room to get it off the square
full and swing, Parthiv throws his arms at it, inside-edges it, and picks two to square leg
shortish and wide, and Hayden leans back, and caresses it through the cover field. Top shot
full and and on the pads, and an easy leg bye
pitched up this time, Parthiv hits and powerfully, and aerially towards mid-on, but doesn't get a run
, this one was fuller, Hayden leant back and swiped at it, mis-hit with the inside half of the bat, Vinay Kumar dives at midwicket, but can't catch it, gets a hand to it, though, and saves four
short again, angling away, parthiv gets it to wide of mid-off, and takes an easy single
short, just outside off, and Parthiv plays it towards covers, can't find the gap
it's all over tonight for Bangalore. It was another leg-side half-volley, Dravid looks for a six over square leg, but picks Flintoff perfectly
slower ball, down the leg, and Dravid misses out again, trying to hit too hard, the fine leg is up, but can't get the placement right
slower ball, Dravid waits fpor it, and cuts it straight to Badri at point, but runs a run anyway. Had Badri hit direct, Dravid was a goner by a long way
full, just outside off, and Kumble opens the face for a single
short, in Kumble's face, who drops his wrists, and the ball at his feet, and wants to get off strike, but Freddie is too alert
full, just short of a yorker, and blasted away towards mid-on, where a misfield from Joginder results in a single
slower ball, on the stumps, and played straight to mid-on
short and fast, Dravid makes room, and cuts it to sqaure of third man
and that's a maiden, via a respectful forward defensive from Kumble
doosra, turns away from the same spot as the last delivery, beats Kumble comprehensively
pitches middle, turns in, beats Kumble's defence, but it's going down leg side

And Steyn denies Murali a five-for, plays it straight to short midwicket, who is Raina, the best fielder in the side, and sets off, only to be sent back, and rightfully so, but Raina has already had his man by then. And it didn't even require a direct-hit
another lovely doosra, floghted outside off, and Steyn plays at it, and watches it go past the outside edge
doosra, starts around off, and turns away, Steyn defends it off the back foot
misses out again, a touch fuller than half-volley, but on pads, and Dravid gets the power, but can't beat Hayden at midwicket
short and on the stumps, Dravid clears his front leg, and pulls over Hayden at midwicket. Too late?
fulltoss, and what does Vinay kumar do? lobs it to Hayden at midwicket, and an easy catch despite the highly distractionous [not a word, but what the heck] orange cap. Bangalore sink in further
another slower ball, and Dravid has already cleared his leg, and wants a forceful shot, but manages just a thick inside edge
slower yorker, on the pads, helped away towards fine leg
misses out here, a half-volley on pads, but Dravid is looking to hit too hard, and misses
steps out this time, is beaten in the flight, gets an inside edge towards fine leg, comes back for two, it is tight, but Dhoni doesn't collect the ball cleanly before whipping off the stumps
another forward defensive, just to right of Murali, wrong game son
good forward defensive, but won't help, one is afraid
doosra, starting in front off, and moving away, outside-edged, past Hayden and his orange cap
short, angling away, Dravid makes room, and takes a single to cover
No. 3 for Murali, flighted, on pads, and Bishnoi, making his debut, gets stuck into it. Little problem, no real elevation, and the long-on is wide, so that it falls straight into his lap
Dravid makes room, and slogs, and is beaten, the ball passes over the stumps

and Jogi hits back, a touch slower, Kohli looks to loft iot, no foot movement, and it goes miles in the air, towards extra cover, Badri and Raina converge, the calling seems clear as only Badri goes for it and holds on
short, and criminal at Joginder's pace, Kohli, despite having committed to front foot, pulls it over square-leg boundary
sharp bouncer, just too high, and Taufel is alert despite taking the hit three balls earlier, and nods to Jerling, who calls it a wide
slower ball, too short, but Dravid mis-hits the pull, lobs to just short of Hayden at midwicket
a bit fuller, and Kohli played it towards long-on
and Rahul cleans Taufel up, that was short, spanked away sqaure, and Taufel saves three. When it rains, it pours, Bangalore will think
thrown up, shorter, outside off, turns in sharply, from round the wicket mind you, and Kohli is just saved through an inside edge
goes back to flighting again, played straight to midwicket, pressure
faster, flatter, on leg, and played straight to fine leg
gets straighter this time, pitches leg, it's the doosra, gets the edge, which goes wide of slip and along the ground
full, flighted, played back to Murali
gets the outside edge with the straighter one, but this one goes along the ground
and beats Kohli again, short, just outside off, some movement away, Kohli hangs his bat out limply, but the ball misses the edge
shorter, on the stumps, 136ks, and nudged away for one
that's quicker than the 135ks the speed gun shows, Dravid looks to cut, but it way too full for that, and is beaten
full, 139ks, and played towards thirdman, with open face
that's Flintoff, at you, short, rising towards the chin, Kohli defends it, with bottom hand coming off
short, outside off, Kohli, much like Uthappa, is committed to front foot, tries to edge it, but misses
full, on the pads, and turned away for a single, what an over from Murali, two wickets, two special deliveries
Murali you beauty! Flight, draws Uthappa out, dips, keeping it short of where Uthappa expected, and then turns it away, and beats the bat, and Dhoni completes a sharp stumping, Bangalore reeling
angling across Dravid, from round the wicket, and played towards mid-off

and he gets KP first ball for a golden duck, and KP is showing Simon Taufel the bat, this one pitched on off, and straightened up, hitting KP in line, with the bat very close to the ball. Pietersen is not a happy man
on the pads,a nd turned away for a single
shortish, turning in, and Uthappa manages to get his pad to an otherwise wide delivery
short, on stumps, turned away towards fine leg

and a frustrated Taylor plays a horrendous shot, the ball goes straight up, ending just to the right of the non-strikers' end, and Flintoff is ready there with his buckets. Superb pressure bowling, and he gets instant results
just short of length, speedgun says 130ks, but seemed faster, on the stumps, and Taylor just defends it
angling into the pads, but is sharp enough for Uthappa to not go for a big shot, a single to midwicket ensues
sharp bouncer, Uthappa's weight is forward already, so can't pull, just ducks
sharp, on the stumps, and Uthappa can only defend it back to the bowler
angling into pads, and flicked away past Parthiv at midwicket, Parthiv gives a good chase and keeps it down to three
lofts it over mid-off, bat face turning in his hand, and just clears Murali, who is incredibly quick in running back
slower delivery, grips a touch, Taylor plays with one hand off the handle
short, sharp, outside off, and Taylor lets it go

Kallis improvises too much for his own good, he walks across a long way, is beaten by a straight and full delivery, pitched outside off, will be touch and go whether it hit him in line. Yepp it hit him in line, and would have taken middle and leg
short, on the off, and Kallis can't free his arms to cut it through covers
lucky for Kallis, makes room, looks to go over extra, is early into ther shot, and the inside-edge goes towards Murali at fine leg
back of a length, just outside off, Ithappa opens the face for a single
slower ball, but won't bother Uthappa, it's wide down the leg
bouncer again, Uthappa had walked down already, so a good delivery, as Uthappa ducks
Uthappa walks down, and this one is in the slot, flat-bats it from outside off to over midwicket, one-bounce for four
slower ball, on the pads, and Kallis misses out on it, pulling it towards sqaure leg
short one tried, Uthappa opens his face for a single to thirdman
slower delivery, outside off, beats Kallis. A good comeback after a gentle loosener from Albie
perfect yorker, and Kallis can only dig it out
yorker, played towards mid-off, which is at the edge of the circle
angled down the leg this time, there was a sound as the ball passed Uthappa, and a tentative appeal, but Simon Taufel didn't see any edge. The ball flicked the trouser on the way through
walks across, sets up for the pull, the ball is short, but not quite short enough, and Uthappa misses, the angle saving an lbw shout
just short of a length, on the off, no room for Uthappa, who has committed to front foot, to do anything with it
half-volley outside off, swinging away a bit, and Uthappa smashes it through extra cover
on the pads, and Uthappa plays it gently between mid-on and midwicket for an easy single. He has faced only two balls in three overs
that's sharp, short, 138ks Kallis looks for the hook, is late into the shot, and is hit in the shoulder, will get a leg bye
short and wide, Kallis misses out on this gift, just a touch early into the shot, slower delivery saved Gony here
slower ball, but way down the leg side, Kallis looks for the easy boundary, but misses
and those 8829 have a treat in Kallis, just outside off, not a half-volley, and Kallis square-drives it, beauty
fuller, closer to off stump, and Kallis plays it back to Gony
furiously cut away, short and wide, and Kallis rocks back, and upper-cuts it over point. Gifts' galore for Kallis
the first ball Uthappa faces, it's another half-volley on the stumps, but Uthappa has moved across, as is his wont, and is squared up a touch in playing it back to the bowler
again, on the pads, it's shorter than driving length, though, and Kallis still drives, this is an on-drvie, mid-on is at the edge of the circle, so an easy single
is Balaji Kallis's friend? a fulltoss on the pads, and lofted over midwicket, easy as you like
not this time, Balaji tempts fate twice, bowls a half-volley on pads again, and Kallis plays a classical flick this time, between midwicket and mid-on
missed out on that, half-volley, on the pads, and Kallis finds short midwicket to perfection
full, just outside off, straightening a touch, and played towards cover with an open face
slower again, Kallis is early into the shot, but rolls his wrists over it, easy single to wide of mid-on
classical cover-drive, neither was this a half-volley, and played on the up, high elbow, the gap found between mid-off and extra, pitcure this
full, straight, played wristily towards mid-on

full, straight, thank you PK, plays all over it, and Gony gets the leg stump. Smart bowling, two bouncers, followed by a full, slower delivery. 0 for 1 after three balls, and the opening experiment has failed for Bangalore
good short ball again, bounces high, beats another swipe from PK
short, and gets it high, PK looks to hit it straight down the ground, mis-hits it towards cover
